objective: Test whether the bounded shared continuous-OI shortlist ranks 16 real pretrained image backbones by the best held-out result across four frozen regression-head families on a naturally continuous spatial target, and whether its five-backbone shortlist is competitive with linear-probe ranking.
scope: One natural real-image target with five disjoint training cohorts and one shared evaluation cohort. Replicates measure training-sample stability, not independent-dataset generalization.

dataset.target: foreground plus boundary pixel count divided by total pixels in the official trimap
dataset.target_pixel_rule: mask_value != 2; official values are foreground=1, background=2, not-classified boundary=3
dataset.sampling: Ten equal-count rank strata over all valid targets; SHA-256 selection order within stratum; 20 images per stratum in every split
dataset.license_scope: Research use per the downloaded archive README; follow the official page and original-image terms

embedding_extraction.recipe: Exact frozen 16-backbone checkpoint roster inherited from continuous_real_age_panel.extract

preprocessing.fit_scope: Complete 200-row training cohort only; the evaluation cohort never participates
preprocessing.purpose: Equalize dimensionality and make the frozen quadratic reference head computationally feasible

reference_heads.selection: Three-fold shuffled training-only GridSearchCV using R2, followed by held-out evaluation
reference_heads.envelope: Maximum held-out R2 across the four frozen head families

continuous_oi.broad_score: RFF-mean feature bandwidth multiplier 4.0 kernel alignment
continuous_oi.shortlist_rule: Preserve the full broad winner group; restrict structured filling to the broad top-2k retrieval pool

bootstrap.unit: training-cohort replicate with shared evaluation cohort
bootstrap.interpretation: seed-stability interval, not an independent-dataset confidence interval

decision_rule.primary: upper95 bounded-minus-linear-probe top-five mean utility regret <= 0
safety: broad top-one opportunity is preserved to absolute tolerance 1e-12
the top-2k retrieval bound is active in every panel
all 20 panel-method rows are complete and finite
decision_rule.interpretation: A pass supports another natural-target panel; it does not establish generalization or authorize library integration.
